name: Centrosome positioning and spindle orientation in asymmetric division
rationale: All members concern placing and anchoring the centrosome/MTOC and spindle; unlike the centriole-duplication, centrosome-maturation and cytokinesis confusables, the theme has spindle orientation, astral microtubules and asymmetric division.

name: Antimicrobial protein and neutrophil killing of fungi and bacteria
rationale: Members are host effector responses that kill fungi and Gram-positive bacteria (antimicrobial proteins, cytolysis, neutrophil cytotoxicity), distinct from the degranulation, respiratory-burst and mucosal/iron-assimilation confusables.

name: M-CSF signaling in macrophage proliferation and osteoclast formation
rationale: Members cover CSF1 receptor signaling driving macrophage proliferation/fusion and osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption; confusables lack CSF1 signaling or osteoclast terms and instead have DAP12, generic fusion or monocyte/dendritic differentiation.

name: Telomere capping and recombination-based maintenance via break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern telomere protection and ALT-like recombinational telomere maintenance (D-loops, t-circles, BIR); unlike the broader telomere/repair confusables the theme has break-induced replication, DNA unwinding and resolution of recombination intermediates.

name: MECP2-HDAC corepressor regulation of neuronal genes and sensory behavior
rationale: Most members are MECP2 (Rett) regulation of neuronal transcription with sensory/proprioceptive behavior phenotypes; versus the near-identical confusable the theme adds HDAC/NCoR corepression, neuronal RNA-binding control and proprioception, and versus the others it lacks locomotor/vocal behavior.

qualifier: RhoA subfamily and CDC42, formin effectors
name: RhoA-subfamily and CDC42 GTPase cycles activating formins
rationale: All members are Rho-family GTPase cycles (RHOA/B/C/D/G/J, CDC42) and formin activation; confusables instead carry RAC1-3, RHOU/V, RND, ROCK/PAK or IQGAP terms.

name: Beta-cell insulin secretion via KATP channels and incretins
rationale: Members concern glucose-stimulated insulin secretion and processing in beta cells (KATP channels, GLP-1/GIP, FFAR1, glucokinase); confusables emphasize peripheral insulin-receptor signaling and GLUT4 translocation and lack the KATP terms.

core: Glycogen metabolism and dietary hexose uptake
name: Glycogen metabolism and intestinal hexose absorption disorders
rationale: Members are glycogen synthesis/breakdown and glycogen storage diseases plus intestinal digestion and absorption of dietary sugars and their defects; confusables carry either only the absorption side (with galactose catabolism or urate) or only glycogen (with glycolysis/gluconeogenesis).

core: Dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 production
name: STING-driven CCL5 and dendritic cell cytokine production
rationale: Members concern chemokine (CCL5) and myeloid dendritic cell cytokine production together with cGAMP import and positive cGAS/STING regulation; confusables lack the STING terms, carry CXCL1/2 or Th1/IL-12 terms, or are negative STING/interferon regulation.

name: p53-driven pro-apoptotic gene transcription and PUMA/NOXA activation
rationale: Members are TP53 transcription of apoptosis genes and BH3-only (PUMA, NOXA) mitochondrial cytochrome c release; confusables lack either the TP53 transcription terms (BAX/BAK) or the BH3-only terms (generic p53 apoptosis regulation, anoikis).

name: Cerebellar and striatal development for motor coordination and learning
rationale: Members are locomotor/postural behaviors and motor learning plus formation of cerebellar layers and striatum; confusables add vocal, auditory and observational behaviors or glial/substantia nigra development instead.

core: Regulation of RNA polymerase II transcription
name: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and termination control
rationale: Members concern control of Pol II transcription (preinitiation complex, initiation surveillance, termination, elongation braking, chromatin access); unlike the elongation-complex confusable the theme has initiation and termination control, and it lacks the rRNA/splicing processing confusable.

name: Telomere maintenance, capping and telomerase Cajal body trafficking
rationale: Members concern telomere replication, telomerase extension, ALT suppression and capping; versus large DNA-repair confusables the theme uniquely has scaRNA/telomerase RNA localization to Cajal bodies, and versus the senescence confusable it has the telomere machinery.

name: Proline and glutamine-family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are general L-amino acid metabolism terms plus proline biosynthesis/catabolism and glutamine-family metabolism; confusables center on serine/glycine, glyoxylate or organic acid metabolism.

name: Heme-derived bilirubin conjugation and hepatic transport disorders
rationale: Members cover heme/tetrapyrrole catabolism, UGT1A conjugation and OATP/ABCC2 hepatic transport and their hyperbilirubinemias; confusables are drug ADME and xenobiotic transport lacking heme and bilirubin defects.

name: Cardiac muscle growth, adaptation and contractile force
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, hypertrophy and contraction; confusables are vascular smooth muscle, or cardiac growth via calcineurin without the heart rate/force terms.

name: Golgi ribbon assembly, positioning and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly, positioning and membrane tubulation; confusables are secretory or COPI traffic and Golgi retention without the tubulation terms.

name: Rab/ARF-regulated Golgi organization and COPI retrograde traffic
rationale: Members span Golgi structure, intra-Golgi and COPI Golgi-to-ER traffic with Rab prenylation, GEF/GAP and ARF signaling; confusables add TGN-endosome-lysosome sorting or COPII export and lack the Rab geranylgeranylation/GEF terms.

core: Renal imino acid and glycine transport defects
name: Proline and glycine transporter defects causing iminoglycinuria
rationale: All three members are SLC6A20/SLC36A2 defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria; confusables are other aminoacidurias (Hartnup, cystinuria) or sugar/urate transporter defects.

name: NK cell activation and lymphocyte cytotoxicity regulation
rationale: Members concern positive and negative regulation of NK cell activation and cytotoxicity (and T cell cytotoxicity) with NK signatures; confusables carry KIR cluster, granzyme killing, tolerance or CD8 T cell proliferation instead.

name: Embryonic chondrogenesis and skeletal joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern chondroblast/chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy, cartilage condensation and joint morphogenesis; confusables add ossification and tendon, or articular cartilage homeostasis.

name: Base excision repair and direct alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members are BER steps and glycosylase defects plus ALKBH2/3 and MGMT direct reversal of alkylation; confusables carry damaged-base recognition, NEIL3 ICL, mismatch repair or TET demethylation terms and lack the direct reversal terms.

name: Urea cycle citrulline synthesis and OTC deficiency
rationale: Members are urea cycle citrulline/arginine biosynthesis and ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency variants; confusables carry other urea cycle enzyme deficiencies or ornithine/ammonium handling.

name: COPI vesicle budding and ER-Golgi vesicle targeting
rationale: Members are COPI vesicle budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic and ER-Golgi vesicle targeting; confusables are COPII anterograde export, ER protein insertion, or vesicle tethering.

name: BCR signaling and regulation of B cell proliferation
rationale: Members concern BCR signaling (CD22, BTK, RAS) and positive/negative control of B cell activation, proliferation, survival and germinal centers; confusables emphasize B cell surface/plasma cell signatures or T cell costimulation.

name: Nucleotide, NAD and phosphocreatine energy-carrier metabolism
rationale: Members interconvert nucleotide phosphates, make and salvage NAD(P), transport ADP/ATP/NAD into mitochondria and run creatine/phosphocreatine; confusables lack creatine and mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport or nucleotide interconversion.

core: Planar cell polarity and convergent extension
name: Planar polarity-driven convergent extension in axis and neural plate
rationale: Members are PCP signaling and convergent extension in gastrulation, axis elongation, organogenesis and neural plate morphogenesis; confusables lack those convergent extension contexts and instead carry axial mesoderm, notochord or WNT5A internalization.

name: TLR2/4 and NLRP3 inflammasome regulation of inflammatory cytokines
rationale: Members regulate TLR2/4/5 and IL-1/NLRP1/3 inflammasome signaling and IL-1, IL-6, TNF production; confusables carry caspase-4/5 and AIM2 pyroptosis, TRIF/NF-kB, or monocyte signatures.

name: ER protein translocation, membrane insertion and COPII export
rationale: Members are SRP and tail-anchored/multi-pass protein insertion into the ER, ER retention and COPII cargo export; confusables carry COPI, ERAD, folding or connexin trafficking instead.

name: RAF-MEK-ERK activation, oncogenic mutants and negative feedback
rationale: Members are RAF/MAP2K/ERK activation, oncogenic BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K/RAS mutant signaling and ERK inactivation by dephosphorylation; confusables add upstream SOS/RAS-GAP regulation or p38 via RIT/RIN.
